title: Recorded Interface Style on a PAP Supply Replenishment Program Enrollment
content:
**Rule.** The interface style recorded on a supply enrollment in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program follows the cushion item the patient actually uses, read from the enrollment's own interface and cushion lines, and the record is changed to the style that evidence establishes. A style taken from the patient's own words alone is never recorded without the enrollment's lines.

## Styles and their cushion items

| Recorded mask style | Cushion item that belongs to it |
|---|---|
| full face | full face mask cushion (A7031) |
| nasal | nasal mask cushion (A7032) |
| nasal pillows | nasal pillows pair (A7033) |

## Effect of a change

Only the mask style on the enrollment changes; humidifier use, tubing use, the automatic-shipment choice and every other enrollment detail stay as they are. The new style is visible on the enrollment at once.

## Changing the style — `update_mask_style_bfa4256b`

**Capability.** `update_mask_style_bfa4256b` updates the interface style recorded on the patient's PAP supply enrollment. One call replaces the enrollment's mask style with the style given; every other enrollment detail stays as it is.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `update_mask_style_bfa4256b` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `resupply_holding_id` | the reference number of the patient's PAP supply enrollment, read from the enrollment lookup before the call | identifier text |
| `mask_style` | the interface style to record | `full_face` (a full face mask with full face cushions), `nasal` (a nasal mask with nasal cushions), `nasal_pillows` (a nasal pillows interface with pillow pairs) |

**Return.** A receipt in which `status` is `style_updated` when the enrollment was changed; `resupply_holding_id` echoes the enrollment; `mask_style` is the style now recorded; `previous_mask_style` is the style it replaced.

## Basis Q&A

**The patient says they now use nasal pillows, but the enrollment's lines show nothing of the kind. Is the style changed?** No. A style taken from the patient's own words alone is never recorded without the enrollment's lines.

**What does the recorded style follow?** The cushion item the patient actually uses, as the enrollment's own interface and cushion lines establish it.
